title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: Senior DevOps role in our London hub: three days a week in the office, two at home. You will manage AWS accounts with Terraform, run Kubernetes with Helm, automate with Ansible and GitHub Actions, and keep dashboards in Prometheus and Docker-based test environments reliable. Python scripting and production on-call are part of the job. 6+ years in DevOps, right to work in the UK required.
